column1: # verb-endings.tsv — verb endings, so the app and the Odia Lens can explain a verb form
# as "verb + ending": ପାଇଛନ୍ତି = "get + have …-ed (they; or respectful)".
# Written by Claude (Anthropic) for this project from its own knowledge of Odia grammar.
# Licence: MIT (this project). Not yet checked by a native speaker (C-13).
# The verb comes from the meaning of its verbal noun in -ବା (owner glosses.tsv or
# meanings.tsv, a meaning that starts "to …"); a form whose verb has no such meaning is
# not explained. Read by explainVerb() in Appv2/src/dictionary/lookup.ts.
#   after_consonant  the ending as written after a root that ends in a consonant: କର + ିଛି
#                    = କରିଛି (it starts with a vowel sign). Empty if none.
#   after_vowel      as written after a root that ends in a vowel: ପା + ଇଛି = ପାଇଛି.
#                    Empty if none (the passive ାଯାଇଛି follows consonant roots only).
#   meaning          English, at most 40 characters; "…" stands for the verb.
#                    No ";" (the chip stops at the first one).
# Checked by core/src/curation.ts parseVerbEndings (strict: canonical Odia, no duplicates).
